unverified: The controller-level causal effect of the selector on learning efficiency is not isolated: this campaign has only one selection so far and no completed outcome, and the observed frontier-first gains are also attributable to the worker-level LEARNING_STATE practice and to toolkit maturation (execution-time defect counts fell from four to zero across the frontier cells).
No quantitative counterfactual comparison against a single-track opportunistic sequence was run; this is out of scope (no numerical reward score and no controller redesign).
No per-checkpoint UTC timestamps were captured; run identity is anchored to run_id 44492888569 and event_sha 618539a4a9627acf46f68bc72b855293fd64c871.

No regression suite was run because no research/, tests/, or examples/ code changed (tests_preceding_process=false); the controller's post-session validation covers record schema and protected-path integrity.
observed_effect: The audit found a concrete advantage for explicit highest-value selection at the selection-principle level: the prior opportunistic pattern chose objectives from receipt/queue follow-ons (activation 37257258857 closed a pending receipt item; activation 37260572520 recorded its process delta as UNVERIFIED specifically because its objective came from a queued receipt item rather than a frontier cell), whereas seven consecutive frontier-first activations each closed a distinct cell with a decisive verdict, independent verification, and no equivalent re-test. The controller selector faithfully implements the same principle via ordinal qualitative ranking plus anti-repeat status transitions. No selector change was made because no bottleneck or capability loss was observed; the residual uncertainty is that the controller's end-to-end causal effect is not yet isolated.
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection improves learning efficiency relative to the repository's prior opportunistic task choice.
uncertainty_reduced: Partially reduced: the selection principle is supported by seven decisive frontier-first closures with no equivalent re-tests versus opportunistic receipt-following, and the controller ranking is consistent with its own metadata; the isolated controller-level causal effect remains open because only one selection has occurred and the gains are confounded by worker-level frontier practice and toolkit maturation.
research_result: NO_NEW_RESEARCH_RESULT — this is a bounded process audit; no market, asset, or hypothesis experiment was run and no research artifact was altered.
